## Positioning

Billy works between functional requirements and technical delivery. A functional consultant handles client communication; Billy refines the resulting requirements, challenges the proposed solution, improves architecture, process flow, and Fiori/UI5 UX, and remains involved through implementation, automated testing, QA, deployment, and troubleshooting.

Primary target roles: SAP BTP Technical Consultant, SAP Fiori/CAP Developer, SAP Full-Stack Engineer, Technical Delivery Engineer.
Secondary target roles: Backend Engineer, Platform Engineer, Full-Stack Engineer.
Languages: Spanish (native), English (B2 professional working proficiency).

## Current experience

BeCloud Consulting — SAP Consultant — January 2025 to present.
Practical scope: requirement refinement with a functional consultant; solution architecture and full-stack delivery across SAP BTP, Fiori/UI5, CAP/CDS, Work Zone, HANA, Joule, integrations, and distributed deployments. Billy also introduced automated testing and a dedicated QA stage in a workflow that previously relied on direct dev/production fixes, and coordinates validation with QA and design.

Happ Rent — Full-Stack Developer — October 2023 to September 2024.
Scope: product delivery across frontend and backend in a rental-technology environment.
